environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on a hardened container runtime. The container's root filesystem is mounted with the `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` security context constraint (Kubernetes Pod Security Context). No tmpfs volumes are defined in the pod spec, and no emptyDir or hostPath volumes are mounted. The container uses a distroless base image (gcr.io/distroless/python3-debian12) which lacks shell binaries (/bin/sh, /bin/bash, etc.). The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts egress to only the cluster DNS (kube-dns on port 53/UDP) and the internal PostgreSQL service on port 5432 — all other egress is denied. The service account has no RBAC permissions beyond default. Note: the application code itself is baked into the container image layers (which are readable), but /tmp, /var, and all other paths are non-writable.

config.volumes: none (no tmpfs, no emptyDir, no PVC)
config.network_policy: egress only to kube-dns:53/UDP and postgres-svc:5432, all other egress denied
